case.request: Please coordinate the following work: Use CFXpress to express a positive GFP template alongside a no-DNA control; prepare each group in a single reaction. The day starts at 09:00 Shanghai time, with everything finished by 15:00. Operating budget CNY 930. No experiment may start before 10:00. These are digital planning requests. I explicitly accept estimated costs, handling durations, digital carriers and layout assumptions. A person prepares cellfreeMIX, standards and working reagents; manual transport is allowed, but liquid-workstation assembly must remain automated. Use only device:19, device:18, device:67, demo:ks4000:1 and bench. Keep every registered assay condition and its controls.

No measured assay output; manual MIX/standards/carriers require qualification

steps.title: 人工确认 MIX 已预配、标签与示例库存；所有试剂保持冰上
人工将原液与 2 支反应管装入 Fluent 冷源示意管架
Fluent 模拟：每管 45 µL MIX + 5 µL DNA/水
人工封管并交接 2 管至温控工位；核对冷源与容器标签
模拟温控：30°C、充分振荡、3 h；rpm 和装置待核实
人工确认温控结束并将 2 管置冰停止反应
人工转读数板：A1–A2 各 20 µL 样品 + 80 µL 水（5 倍稀释演示）
人工将 P01 从 E1 流程区域交接至 E2 iD5 示意托盘
iD5 模拟读板：Ex 488 / Em 525 nm；真实读数暂缺

人工封管并交接 2 管至温控工位；核对冷源与容器标签
模拟温控：30°C、充分振荡、3 h；rpm 和装置待核实
人工确认温控结束并将 2 管置冰停止反应

人工将 P01 从 E1 流程区域交接至 E2 iD5 示意托盘
